response.sql: WITH per_account AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans WHERE amount > 2400 GROUP BY account_id) SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(avg_balance) AS avg_balance FROM per_account

assumptions.assumption: The cutoff means transactions with amount strictly greater than 2400.

alternatives.interpretation: If the cutoff includes transactions of exactly 2400, use amount >= 2400.
